narrative.details:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
narrative.objectives: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
